name: Multimodal AI: Image, Audio and Video
summary: The model also sees and hears: read documents, generate images, transcribe audio and understand video.
prerequisites: Requires knowing how a model is chosen. The multimodal one is chosen the same way, on different criteria.
syllabus: What changes when the model can see and hear
Text to speech and speech to text
APIs: Vision, DALL-E, Whisper and the alternatives
topics: Multimodal AI use cases in real products
Image understanding: description, extraction and document reading
Image generation: prompt, style and limits
Video understanding: frames, transcription and summarising
Audio processing: noise, speaker separation and segmentation
Text to speech (TTS): voices, intonation and latency
Speech to text (STT): accuracy, language and domain vocabulary
LangChain and LlamaIndex in multimodal applications
Cost, file size and upload limits
Accessibility: captions, audio description and transcription
